curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Given just twenty-four hours to decide, how far will a regular family go when sudden wealth comes with fatal, irrevocable consequences?
curatedMovie.description: Suburban parents Norma and Arthur Lewis receive a simple wooden box from an enigmatic stranger offering $1 million at the press of a button—on the condition that a stranger somewhere will die.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Tense, morally weighty sci-fi suspense with a deliberate, high-pressure pace that demands close attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Richard Kelly transforms a stark ethical puzzle into an eerie, suspenseful sci-fi thriller driven by mounting dread and irreversible choices.
